label: lem:row-quotient-geometry
scope: Finite-dimensional centered energy, the vector pairwise-variance identity, the direct pair-distance bound, and the centered-energy collapse implication.
excluded: Attainment of the finite maximum, the reverse diameter-to-energy bound, and the three-way sequence equivalence.

label: thm:layer-resolved-gate-shape
scope: The finite nonnegative coordinate factorization and equivalence between total-energy convergence and convergence of every mixed coordinate energy.
excluded: Matrix row centering, Frobenius column assembly, and transfer to maximum physical row diameter.

label: thm:block-orbit-criterion
paper: Necessary and sufficient block orbit criterion
scope: Attained finite block maxima, exact anchor-plus-excursion identity, the nonnegative block collapse equivalence, and domination by positive variation.
excluded: Passage from successive unbounded blocks to the complete natural-number orbit and the finite-registry maximum.

label: thm:implemented-adamw-lift
scope: The abstract three-block lifted state action, its block expansion, and cancellation of state-independent additive forcing from a perturbation response.
excluded: Construction of live Hessian, clipping, bias-correction, denominator, and decay blocks from the implemented optimizer.

label: thm:complete-state-collapse
scope: Transfer from a vanishing nonnegative complete-state normal and vanishing physical baseline through a uniform linear physical cover.
excluded: Chart construction, scheduled metrics, nonlinear tube induction, chronological scalar unrolling, and the uniform context-class extension.

label: thm:finite-cocycle-envelope
scope: Chronological finite iteration of the nonnegative affine scalar estimate used after the nonlinear tube bound.
excluded: The tube induction, scheduled norms, and finite physical-cover maximum.

label: cor:linear-stochastic-forcing
excluded: Martingale orthogonality, the transported second-moment bound, and its mean-square consequence.

label: thm:collapse-obstructions
scope: Necessity of vanishing realized force under vanishing successor components, its contrapositive obstruction, and an explicit finite-prefix reopening counterexample.
excluded: The common-observation-kernel counterexample and the degenerating scheduled-metric counterexample.

label: thm:plga-quotient-defect
scope: The abstract response-plus-defect bound, exact reduction at zero upstream quotient, and obstruction from a nonzero constant-input defect.
excluded: The implemented PLGA formula, segment integral construction of the response bound, and sequential transfer.

label: prop:plga-row-preservation
excluded: Propagation of row constancy through the five implemented PLGA parameter conditions.
